items.title: 33.8 Rules and Regulations regarding Waste Pollution and Conservation

source_refs.note: Topic 33.8 with Table 33.3 and the Did You Know box (PDF 259). Laws and penalties are carried as printed and not verified against current statutes; flagged for review. Exercises (PDF 260-261) excluded.

blocks.text: The Government of Punjab has made several acts and laws to deal with water pollution within its jurisdiction. The Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Punjab regularly issues rules and regulations for all concerned stakeholders. Table 33.3 gives an overview of key rules and regulations on water pollution control and conservation, as printed in the book.

blocks.caption: Table 33.3 Key environmental regulations and conservation measures (as printed in the book)
rows: Fines up to Rs 5 million, plus additional daily fines of up to Rs 100,000
Prohibits discharging pollutants or blocking flow
Up to 3 months' imprisonment and/or a Rs 500,000 fine
Punjab Irrigation, Drainage and Rivers Act, 2023
Sets water use and drainage fees; regulates discharge permits to prevent industrial and agricultural pollution
Punjab Water and Sanitation Authority Act, 2025
Establishes the Authority in major cities (Lahore, Multan, etc.) for integrated resource management and groundwater conservation

blocks.title: Check the current law
blocks.text: The acts, penalties and the Did You Know fine are carried as printed in the book and have not been checked against the current statutes. Laws and fines change; refer to EPA Punjab and the official gazette for the current text. Flagged for review.

blocks.title: Did you know?
blocks.text: The book states that the penalty for using hosepipes for car washing, and for flood irrigation of domestic lawns or gardens, is a fine of Rs 10,000 under the Pakistan Penal Code.

blocks.prompt: Which Punjab act prohibits discharging pollutants or blocking the flow of water, and what penalty does the book give?
blocks.explanation: The Punjab Water Act, 2019; up to 3 months' imprisonment and/or a Rs 500,000 fine.

items: EPA Punjab issues rules on water pollution.
Acts: Environmental Protection Act 1997, Water Act 2019, Irrigation, Drainage and Rivers Act 2023, Water and Sanitation Authority Act 2025.
